general.title: General statement
general.p1: {{shopLegalName}} is committed to protecting your privacy and takes its responsibilities regarding the security of customer information seriously. This notice explains how we use personal data and how we protect your privacy when you interact with our shop, website, and services.
general.contactLead: If you have questions, contact us at
general.contactDpo: For CCTV or data protection complaints, you may contact our DPO at

dataCollect.title: Data we collect
dataCollect.p1: Depending on your interaction with us, we may collect: name, gender, date of birth, address, email, phone number, booking history, service notes, complaint/feedback records, payment details, cookie/device and technical usage data, social media handle (if you message us), and CCTV images captured at premises.
dataCollect.p2: Where legally required to verify age for tattooing, we may request and retain a copy of photo identification with your consent documentation.

whenCollect.title: When we collect data
whenCollect.p1: We collect data when you use our website or account, make a booking or purchase, contact us, enter promotions, complete surveys, leave reviews, engage on social media, or otherwise interact with our business.

lawfulBases.title: Lawful bases (UK GDPR / EU GDPR)
lawfulBases.p1: We rely on consent, contractual necessity, legal obligation, legitimate interests, and vital interests depending on context.
lawfulBases.consentDesc: e.g. newsletter opt-in and optional cookie categories.
lawfulBases.contractDesc: to provide booked services and process payments/deposits.
lawfulBases.legalDesc: where required to share data for fraud/crime prevention or legal process.
lawfulBases.legitimateDesc: business operations, communications, service updates, and quality improvement.
lawfulBases.vitalDesc: where needed to protect life/health in emergencies.

howUse.title: How and why we use data
howUse.p1: We use personal data to provide services, manage bookings and deposits, send required service communications, process complaints and feedback, improve products and systems, administer surveys and competitions, protect security, and meet legal obligations.
howUse.p2: {{shopLegalName}} does not share marketing data with third-party organizations for their own marketing. We do share data with payment and service providers where necessary to run transactions and operations securely.

cookies.title: Cookies, pixels, and website technologies
cookies.p1: Cookies and similar technologies help us run website features and remember preferences. Our cookies are not intended to contain direct personal identifiers. You can manage browser cookies and in-app cookie preferences.
cookies.p2: We may use email tracking pixels to understand whether emails were opened and whether your client can render text or HTML content.

security.title: Security and retention
security.p1: We use encryption, secure processing standards, and access controls to protect data. No internet transmission is entirely risk free, but we apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards.
security.p2: Standard retention is at least 5 years from last visit/transaction, or longer where legal/insurance claims require this. For insurance and damages claims we may retain relevant data up to 21 years.

cctv.title: CCTV policy summary
cctv.p1: Our premises are monitored by CCTV 24/7 for prevention/detection of crime, safety, and asset protection. Cameras are placed in prominent areas and not in sensitive spaces. Access is restricted to authorized trained personnel.
cctv.p2: CCTV data is processed lawfully, fairly, transparently, and securely. Footage is generally stored for a minimum of 14 days and no longer than 1 year unless required for investigations, disciplinary proceedings, or legal evidence.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You may request access, correction, deletion (where applicable), restriction, objection, portability, and withdrawal of consent. You can also ask us to stop direct marketing. You can request a copy of your data by emailing
rights.p2: If we refuse a request, we will explain why. You also have the right to complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) or your local EU supervisory authority.

updates.title: Policy updates
updates.p1: We may update this notice periodically. Material changes will be posted here so you remain aware of what data we collect, how we use it, and when it may be disclosed.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.p1: These Terms govern access to and use of the {{platformName}} web application (the "Service") by staff and customers in the UK and EU. By using the Service, you agree to these Terms.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility and account security
eligibility.p1: You must provide accurate information, keep credentials confidential, and notify us promptly of unauthorized account access. You are responsible for activity carried out under your account unless caused by our fault.

acceptableUse.title: 3. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.p1: You must not misuse the Service, interfere with security controls, upload unlawful content, or use the Service in a way that breaches applicable law, including UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and consumer protection rules.

bookings.title: 4. Booking and deposit workflows
bookings.p1: The Service supports booking management and deposit reminders. Payment handling is provided by integrated third-party providers. You are responsible for ensuring booking and payment information entered is correct before sending notifications.
bookings.p2: Additional studio terms apply to booked tattoo services: once tattooing services are provided, the agreed price is payable in full and no credit is offered; deposits are collected via online payment provider integration; deposits are refundable only where formal cancellation is made by email at least 24 hours before the appointment; and dissatisfaction with style preference changes after service does not create a refund entitlement.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual property
ip.p1: The Service design, software, and content are protected by intellectual property rights. You may use the Service only for internal business or personal booking purposes and not for unauthorized copying, resale, or reverse engineering.

data.title: 6. Data protection
data.p1: Personal data is processed in line with our Privacy Notice and applicable UK/EU data protection law. Where required, we rely on consent, contract, legal obligation, or legitimate interests as a lawful basis.

availability.title: 7. Service availability
availability.p1: We aim for reliable operation but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. Planned maintenance, updates, and third-party outages may affect access.

liability.title: 8. Liability
liability.p1: Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited under law (including fraud or death/personal injury caused by negligence). Subject to mandatory law, we exclude indirect losses and limit liability to foreseeable direct losses arising from breach.

changes.title: 9. Changes and termination
changes.p1: We may update these Terms where required by law, security, or product changes. Material changes are published in-app with a revised date. We may suspend or terminate access where terms are breached or misuse is detected.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing law
governingLaw.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales, unless mandatory consumer law in your country of residence provides otherwise.

what.title: 1. What cookies are
what.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We also use similar technologies (such as local storage) where needed for application functionality and user preferences.

categories.title: 2. Cookie categories we use
categories.p1: Strictly necessary: required for authentication, security, session handling, and core features. Preferences: store UI and usability choices. Analytics: help us understand performance and usage trends. Marketing: support campaign effectiveness and tailored promotion.

consent.title: 3. Consent model
consent.p1: Strictly necessary technologies are always active. Optional categories (preferences, analytics, marketing) are activated only after your consent and can be changed any time from the cookie preferences interface.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-party services
thirdParty.p1: Some integrated providers may set their own cookies or similar identifiers when their functionality is used. Their privacy/cookie terms apply in addition to this policy.

pixels.title: Email pixels
pixels.p1: We may include tracking pixels in certain emails to understand engagement (for example, whether an email was opened) and content rendering capability (text vs HTML). This helps us improve communication quality and relevance.

manage.title: 5. How to manage cookies
manage.p1: You can accept all, reject non-essential, or set granular choices in-app. You can also configure your browser to block cookies, but this may impact core features such as sign-in or secure session handling.

updates.title: 6. Updates
updates.p1: We may update this policy to reflect legal, technical, or product changes. The latest version and update date are always published here.

depositCheckout.title: Checkout
depositCheckout.subtitle: Pay your deposit to secure your booking
depositCheckout.vipExempt: Because you are a VIP customer, you are not required to pay a deposit. Please let us know if anything changes.
